description.value: Voyage Liquor is a locally owned chain that has been serving Vancouver Island and Salt Spring Island since 2006, with the Duncan location being one of five stores. It stocks a curated mix of local, national, and global wines, spirits, and beers, with staff described as friendly and knowledgeable. Same-day delivery and a loyalty rewards program are also available, which could be handy for cyclists planning a rest-day resupply.
